chapter: Players and bands of old New Orleans
title: Manuel Perez outblowing Joe Oliver
summary: Laurent says Manuel Perez was the best cornetist of his boyhood and describes him beating Joe Oliver at a wagon contest.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I was gonna ask about some of the old time trumpet players in carnet. Who were the best carnet players when you were a boy, when you were first banding?
Well I'm gonna give you the full swing of it now, since you asked me that. Manuel Perez blowed them all up.
Manuel Perez blowed them up a breeze. Man, they used to stop at the corner of my house in them old time furniture wagging.

Joe Oliver on one side, Manuel Perez on this side. Manuel put his browns on that little trumpet he had. And he started playing. When he got through, he had Joe Oliver spitting lumps of blood like that, trying to catch him. Yeah, he had Joe Oliver spitting lumps of blood right there at that corner praying around for us.
Manuel Perez used the derby too and all of them. Yeah.
He sees derby. They didn't have no, none of them,

Illuminant hats or nothing like that. No mutes or nothing. He sees derby. Kid Punch, all of them. Oh man. Guy Kelly. All them old trumpet players. All them old trumpet players. But Manny Perez would put them all to sleep.
He was the tops you thought.
Good reader. He was a good reader.
